decisions.reason: A same-message Event already captures the bushing placement and clearance decision. The 40 mm bushing-space dimension is owned by the main-shaft geometry Requirement and does not invalidate or change the candidate's current guidance and retention attributes.
The same-message Event already establishes the piston-end arrangement and rod path. The 55 mm inner diameter is a main-shaft geometry constraint and does not change those sliding-mandrel attributes.

The existing same-message Event already records premachining, welding, and final machining after welding. The source geometry details refine what is machined without requiring another fabrication-sequence state change.
The assembly-based numbering rule is independently captured from the same message and remains unchanged by the main-shaft geometry modification.
The source changes shaft geometry and machining details but does not change the specified S355 JRG2 or CuSn12 materials.
The main-shaft geometry decision does not alter ČSN/EN compliance, template availability, or any other drawing-standard attribute.
The geometry corrections may require work on the model, but they do not change the standing requirement to deliver a 3D assembly model. Implementation status must not be propagated.
The source does not change the requested IPT or STEP delivery formats or their preference order.
The dimensional and feature corrections are state of the main-shaft geometry Requirement; the source does not independently change a general rule governing technical-drawing annotations.
The client supplies corrections to drawing content but does not change the requirement to provide a complete manufacturing drawing set or establish a new deliverable-state attribute.
